column1: # Basilauncher partition map (16MB). Factory is the launcher — never written by the app UI.
# Guest apps live only in ota_0..ota_3. One large slot (~6MB) fits larger readers; smaller
# slots take lighter firmwares. A 1MB spiffs/LittleFS partition is required for guests
# that expect Meshtastic-style InternalFS (label "spiffs"); without it they hang on boot.
